title: Wheel of Wild Magic
description: Turns the sorcerer's Wild Magic Surge table into a game show. When anyone rolls it, a prize wheel of all 50 surges spins on everyone's screen, ticks, slows, sometimes fakes you out, and lands on the real result. A smug reality-show System AI then announces your fate with commentary, achievements and reward boxes, and a matching chat card (with a Replay button) is posted. Underneath it is still an ordinary RollTable draw. Includes the table, an optional dnd5e surge check and Wild Magic Surge 5e support. Any other roll table can use the wheel too.

recommends.reason: Wraps RollTable#draw politely, so the wheel plays nicely with other modules that also change how roll tables are drawn.
